title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：rose　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rose 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the grower ① grew the rose that no buyer in the greenhouse would have described, and he said the growing was the whole of the summer. The ② rose, meaning the flower itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a rose, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ rose in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ rose at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rose, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grower said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rose was the whole of the matter, meaning the love and not the flower. The ⑥ rose, meaning the love and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; rose, he said, is either something you grow or the only word that means both a flower and a love. He said the love is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ rose had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ rose of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of describing; rose, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rose I remember is the flower described in the ledger, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the greenhouse. A ⑩ rose, my mother said in 1980, is the only flower that improves by being described; every rose, she said, is a love that has agreed to look like a flower. She said the love was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 玫瑰（指大棚里每一朵旁边的那一朵）
B. n. 玫瑰（指那朵玫瑰本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：grow the rose 种这一朵玫瑰
D. n. 玫瑰（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 玫瑰之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的玫瑰之事）
F. n. 玫瑰（指收成账里写到、被描述的那一朵）
G. n. 玫瑰、情意（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 情意（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: grew the rose that no buyer in the greenhouse would have described
The rose, meaning the flower itself and not the crate
the rose at the far shelf
the rose was the whole of the matter
the rose had become a line in a ledger
The rose of the whole thing
A rose, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: grow the rose 意为“种这一朵玫瑰”，1971 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯描述的一朵玫瑰做了一遍。
rose 意为“玫瑰”，指那朵玫瑰本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
rose 意为“玫瑰”，指大棚里每一朵旁边的那一朵，每一朵旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
rose 意为“玫瑰”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rose 意为“玫瑰、情意”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这朵情意就是那件事的全部。
rose 意为“情意”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那朵玫瑰，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rose 意为“玫瑰”，指收成账里写到、被描述的那一朵，到 1976 年这一朵成了收成账里的一行。
rose 意为“玫瑰之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的玫瑰之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的描述。
rose 意为“玫瑰”，我记得的是收成账里描述过的那一朵，1978 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一朵。
rose 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，玫瑰是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的玫瑰。
